payload.prepared_query: Which USGS-tracked country dominates the global mineral refined by NVIDIA's disclosed Tin smelters across a 3-hop path?

payload.sql:
WITH vector_hits AS (
  SELECT
    base.entity_id,
    base.canonical_name,
    base.entity_type,
    base.jurisdiction,
    base.risk_tier,
    base.exposure_usd,
    base.data_origin,
    base.source_license,
    distance
  FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
    (SELECT * FROM `acc05_enterprise_graphrag.entities` WHERE pack_id = @pack_id AND ARRAY_LENGTH(embedding) > 0),
    'embedding',
    (SELECT @query_embedding AS embedding),
    top_k => 6,
    distance_type => 'COSINE'
  )
),
lexical_hits AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    canonical_name,
    entity_type,
    jurisdiction,
    risk_tier,
    exposure_usd,
    data_origin,
    source_license,
    0.05 AS distance
  FROM `acc05_enterprise_graphrag.entities`
  WHERE pack_id = @pack_id
    AND (
      (LENGTH(canonical_name) >= 3 AND STRPOS(LOWER(@query_text), LOWER(canonical_name)) > 0)
      OR (
        LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(canonical_name), r'\s+(corporation|corp|inc|ltd|llc|co|limited|group|holdings)\.?$', '')) >= 4
        AND STRPOS(
          LOWER(@query_text),
          REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(canonical_name), r'\s+(corporation|corp|inc|ltd|llc|co|limited|group|holdings)\.?$', '')
        ) > 0
      )
    )
  LIMIT 6
)
SELECT
  entity_id,
  canonical_name,
  entity_type,
  jurisdiction,
  risk_tier,
  exposure_usd,
  data_origin,
  source_license,
  distance
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM vector_hits
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM lexical_hits
)
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY distance ASC) = 1
ORDER BY distance ASC
LIMIT 6

stage_events.label: Traverse BigQuery Property Graph (ISO GQL, up to 3 hops)

payload.gql:
GRAPH acc05_enterprise_graphrag.EnterpriseGraph
MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (src:Entity)-[hops:Rel]->{1,3}(dst:Entity)
WHERE src.pack_id = @pack_id AND dst.pack_id = @pack_id AND src.entity_id IN UNNEST(@seed_ids)
LET hop_count = PATH_LENGTH(p),
    min_confidence = MIN(hops.confidence),
    path_exposure_usd = MAX(hops.exposure_usd)
FILTER min_confidence >= @min_confidence
RETURN
  src.entity_id AS start_id,
  dst.entity_id AS end_id,
  dst.entity_type AS end_type,
  dst.risk_tier AS end_risk_tier,
  hop_count,
  path_exposure_usd,
  min_confidence,
  TO_JSON(NODES(p)) AS path_nodes_json,
  TO_JSON(EDGES(p)) AS path_edges_json
ORDER BY path_exposure_usd DESC, hop_count ASC
LIMIT 120
